pairs.question: Cur enim partitis vicibus anni brumalis abscedit aut noctium opacitate terras reficit?
pairs.answer: Exusturus haut dubie, et sic quoque exurens quadam in parte.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question (about the sun, subject established by the surrounding passage on solar magnitude) immediately self-answered. Dropped the section marker [52] and the introductory clause 'id quidem et tacitis naturae ipsius indiciis:' that precedes the question. Answer ends at the first full stop; the following flourish 'tanta magnitudo est.' restates the size point rather than answering the 'cur', so it is excluded. Capitalization of the first word of question and answer normalized.
